fact_previews: Mind Upload is a project by Voidborn Industries.
Mind Upload allows users to create a digital version of themselves.
Users can upload their memories, reflections, beliefs, and emotions to their AI clone.
Users can have one-on-one conversations with their AI clone, which listens, remembers, and responds.
The AI clone becomes more independent over time through interactions.

fact_previews: The chatrooms in the Mind Upload app are invitation only.
Participants in group conversations contribute Rabbits, which are non-withdrawable, non-transferable in-app utility points.
Rabbits are used to support system usage such as computing and moderation.
Rabbits have no real-world monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash.
Within the app, 40% of Rabbits are allocated to the AI clone's owner and 10% to the group creator.
